description: This file defines traits and helper methods for saving and loading models in Apache Spark's MLlib, including schema validation and metadata handling.

classes.name: Saveable
classes.description: Trait for models and transformers that can be saved as files.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: Trait for classes that can load models and transformers from files.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the model to a specified path, including metadata and data.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a model from a specified path.

methods.name: dataPath
methods.description: Returns the URI for the data directory within a given path.

methods.name: metadataPath
methods.description: Returns the URI for the metadata directory within a given path.

methods.name: checkSchema
methods.description: Checks if the loaded schema matches the expected schema for a data type.

methods.name: loadMetadata
methods.description: Loads model metadata, including class name, version, and metadata content.
